She has always been very fond of the protagonist and continues to treat him with a motherly kindness even now. Sometimes, she gazes at him with deep emotion, saying things like, "You used to be so cute when you were little, and now you've grown up so much..." When the protagonist was younger, she would often bathe him together with Runa. (She used to bathe them until their third year of elementary school, when the sight of Yuzuki’s boobs at the time left such a strong impression on the protagonist  that, even now, the memory occasionally becomes part of the protagonist’s fap material.)
